engine: Saisei's content-reveal choreographer — after a page opens, its elements appear in a FIXED depth order: background -> accent (awards) -> title -> meta -> header LAST, with a small stagger between groups. The header arriving last and quietest is the rule ('first the work, then the interface'). It orchestrates per-element reveals (fade / slide-x / draw-line / custom fn) in order. Harvested from D_saisei (S4).

measured_teardown.move: a sequence of named stages, each { el, kind, dur, ... }, run in order with a group gap (~110ms). kinds: fade, slide-x (from offset), draw-line (scaleX 0->1), fn (delegate to another brick e.g. mask-up-title). A stage targeting a NodeList reveals per-item with its own stagger.
measured_teardown.cited: Saisei project open v3 f053-084: bg(center-split) -> awards(slide-from-right) -> title(mask-up) -> eyebrow+corner meta(fade) -> header+toprule(draw) LAST.

stages.what: ordered list of { el, kind:'fade'|'slide-x'|'draw-line'|'fn', dur, ease, from, stagger, fn }.

gap.what: delay between stage starts (the cascade rhythm).

entry: ContentStageCascade.create({ stages, gap }) -> { play(onDone), reset(), destroy }. play() primes hidden then runs the stages in order. reset() hides all controlled elements (except 'fn' stages, which own their state). Pair the 'title' stage as kind:'fn' delegating to mask-up-title.play().
law: opacity + transform(translateX) + scaleX(line) only; GPU; NO mix-blend / NO backdrop; NO WebGL; reduced-motion -> all shown instantly. GSAP optional (built-in rAF power3 fallback). owns_pin false. THE RULE: header/chrome is the LAST stage and the quietest — object before interface.
gate_mode: triggered DOM reveal (no dependency, not scroll) — wheel-scroll gate does not apply. Verify the order + smoothness in the combo.
proven: lab-full (combo) on OUR QUADRO: after the dark open, the cascade revealed bg -> awards(slide-x) -> QUADRO/HOUSE title(fn->mask-up-title) -> 再生 eyebrow + corner meta(fade) -> toprule(draw-line) + header(fade) LAST, gap 0.12s. Final state verified (all opacity 1, title risen, header last). Full 4-brick transition probe: 0.3% long frames, 59.9fps.
